raw:
(1) BAKED TEXT — ZERO. There are no letters, numbers, or words baked into the skin.

(2) LAYOUT ADHERENCE — Fails. The layout is severely broken. Multiple controls are either missing or misplaced. The 'next' button is completely absent, rendered only as an empty circular recess. Furthermore, the interactive hardware for three other controls—the volume knob, the seek slider handle, and the shuffle toggle switch—are not integrated into the main device body. Instead, they are painted separately on a miscellaneous "strip" below the player, while the main body only contains their empty slots. This is a gross misplacement and a failure to assemble the final design.

(3) GUIDE-COLOUR RESIDUE — ZERO. All guide colours have been successfully removed, with no visible rings, rims, or floods of the specified colours around any of the controls. The colours of the buttons themselves are part of the intended skeuomorphic design.

(4) OVERALL QUALITY — POOR. Although the artistic rendering of the individual components that are present (the casing, the water drop effects, the rendered buttons) is EXCELLENT, with deep, rich skeuomorphic detail, the skin as a whole is incomplete and non-functional. The missing 'next' button and the disassembled state of the volume, seek, and shuffle controls make the final product fundamentally broken.

VERDICT: FAIL
